{{short description|American mathematician}}

'''Valery Alexeev''' (born 1964)<ref>{{cite web |title=Alexeev, Valery, 1964- |url=https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2006126664.html |website=id.loc.gov |access-date=January 6, 2021}}</ref> is an American mathematician who is currently the David C. Barrow Professor at [[University of Georgia]], and an Elected Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=Fellows |publisher=ams.org |accessdate=April 25, 2017 |archive-date=August 25, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.math.uga.edu/directory/valery-alexeev |title=Valery Alexeev |publisher=uga.edu |accessdate=April 25, 2017}}</ref> He received his PhD from Lomonosov Moscow State University in 1990.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=75252 |title=Valery Alexeev |publisher=genealogy.math.ndsu |accessdate=January 6, 2021}}</ref>
